description: A defect, end to end: from the report to a merged fix, with the requirements and a summary at the end. ref = the repo or folder the fix is in (optional).

steps.title: The report understood: what happens, what should happen, where (requirements written with `board req`)
Reproduced: a failing test or a recorded run that shows it
Root cause found (the line and the reason, not the symptom)
Verified: the failing test passes, the suite passes, the real thing run
Summary written (board summary): cause, fix, how it was verified
